film.product: Kissflow Agentic App Builder — an enterprise low-code platform where AI agents build business apps from a requirements document, with governance at every step
film.audience: enterprise IT leaders and business buyers who just had a sales call
film.purpose: a 90-second product film sent after sales calls and posted on LinkedIn
film.tone_wanted: professional, premium, trustworthy, confident; calm authority with one energetic burst in the middle
film.narration: a soft young female voice-over speaks for about 70 of the 90 seconds
film.structure: hook 0-6s; problem 6-13s; seven-step process 13-42s with a fast verification montage at 32-41s; one beat of silence at 41s; hero reveal at 43s; calmer close 54-90s
film.user_feedback_on_previous_music: The previous marimba score was called 'funny' and 'not professional'.
